text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Satono 
Diamond, we stopped by a shopping mall—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
There are so many shops, I can hardly 
choose. Eventually, I shall conquer them 
all—oh my?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, hey, then what about this one? 
Does it look mature? Or maybe this one 
is—"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ah! It's Satono-chan☆ Yahoo~!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Mayano-san, Creek-san! Are you out 
shopping?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, that's right~. Creek-san is helping 
me pick out some grown-up clothes♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't decide at all, though. Because 
Maya wanted absolutely eve-ry-thing☆

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Maya-chan looks cute in whatever she 
wears, so I find myself indecisive too~.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
My! In that case, may I lend a hand as 
well? I want to find an outfit that looks 
great on Mayano!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I ended up helping Mayano Top Gun 
pick out clothes.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, this is surprisingly tricky. If it 
were my own clothes, I could decide right 
away, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be that the criteria are simply 
different from when I choose things for 
myself?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, how do you think we should go 
about choosing?
choice_data_list:
I'll prioritize something that suits 
Mayano Top Gun.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I see, deciding on a direction is very 
important!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Then, I'll think about it once more! 
...Fufu, what should I do?♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I've decided! Mayano-san, how does that 
combination sound to you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond put together an outfit 
featuring a calm, coordinated color 
palette.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wah, a white blouse with a navy skirt! It 
feels so chic, elegant, and grown-up~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Since it has a high waist, it'll make my 
legs look longer and sexy♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Who knew a combo like this could work~! 
That's definitely something new to learn☆"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm just glad you liked it.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Still, Satono-chan, how do you know such a 
mature pairing like this?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... I think it's because, as a 
member of the Satono family, I often 
appear in public.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Especially since social parties are mostly 
attended by adults.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thinking about standing alongside everyone 
without looking out of place, I inevitably 
end up choosing a lot of chic, subdued 
colors.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wooww... A social gala sounds so 
grown-up!!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, do you think Maya will get to 
attend social parties as a sophisticated 
lady someday?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Of course! We often invite Umamusume who 
are active competitors, after all!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Really!? Then Maya's gotta get ready for 
the social party☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Satono-chan, I want you to teach me 
lots more mature combinations~♪"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course! Leave it all to me!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, they're both so cute~. Frolicking 
around like that♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I see...! There's no point unless we find 
something that truly suits the wearer, 
after all!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see... Then let me think about it 
for a bit. Fufu♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I've decided! Mayano-san, how does that 
combination sound to you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond put together an outfit that 
combined cuteness with a lively flair.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I thought the ruffles were absolutely 
adorable, but do you care for them?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's super lovely~! And the 
ribbons on the sleeves make for such a 
nice accent☆

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: That is correct! You noticed quite well!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The ribbon is small enough that it won't 
get in the way of the cuffs, so it should 
make a lovely little accent♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, the bottoms are nice and short, 
just the way Maya likes it, super cute☆

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And you see, if we're matching shoes in 
this case—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
âAh, Maya figured it out!! It's short 
boots, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Exactly! As expected of you, 
Mayano-san, you understand so well!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Since the bottoms are short, making the 
boots shorter too should make your legs 
look longer!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, totally get it~! Plus showing 
some leg is a little sexy, right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maybe Satono-chan and I have similar 
tastes~☆ Hey, hey, let's keep looking 
together!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, absolutely! Let's go check them out 
one by one starting over there♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, they're both so cute~. Frolicking 
around like that♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Creek-san! Would you two care to 
join us as well~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a while after that, the four of us 
enjoyed looking for clothes.
